verdict.rationale: A government digital-administration portal could plausibly publish a public API with interactive documentation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API reference or runnable examples. Keyless probes found only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell on the ANEF host and a Cloudflare challenge on the parent ministry site, with every transaction behind an account.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
